text: The authors propose Iterated Amplification, a training strategy that progressively builds up a training signal for problems too complicated for a human to evaluate directly by combining solutions to easier subproblems. They describe it as closely related to Expert Iteration but using no external reward function, and report results only in algorithmic environments showing it can efficiently learn complex behaviors.
title: Iterated Amplification: training signal built by combining solutions to easier subproblems
